result.content:
# Proposed discovery plan

Determine whether to build a dedicated handoff tracking tool tailored for small software teams in Latvia.

## Proposed scope

- Exploration of handoff coordination workflows among small software teams (5-30 people) in Latvia.
- Evaluation of recurring time loss and friction during end-of-week and sprint transition handoffs.
- Identification of gaps in existing team tooling, strictly excluding payroll, invoicing, and financial advisory capabilities.

Region: Latvia

Explicit exclusions: Do not include payroll or financial advice

## Engineering Lead

Responsible for sprint execution, developer workflows, and team-level operational syncs.

- How much team time is consumed preparing and compiling handoff updates each week? (question-61c8ef81f2ca4fac5060cdac)
- What current tools or automations handle team status handoffs, and why do manual workarounds persist? (question-f1d5e924fdb303e65b3b1996)

## Operations or Delivery Manager

Oversees cross-functional delivery alignment, tooling budgets, and process improvements.

- Under what conditions would your team purchase a dedicated handoff utility versus configuring existing project management software? (question-dccc8636dbed1520b6dcf3bd)

## Simulation hypotheses

- We spend two hours copying handoff updates each Friday. [source:operator-interview]

## Assumptions

- Small engineering teams in Latvia experience recurring manual overhead when consolidating handoff updates.
- Teams prefer lightweight workflow utilities over enterprise-heavy workflow orchestration platforms.

## Evidence gaps

- No verified market data on software team counts or tool spend in Latvia.
- Lack of verified customer feedback comparing standalone handoff tools against native integrations in existing project trackers.
- No non-synthetic source findings were established; the plan is a proposal, not customer validation.

This scope is proposed, not a claim of user approval.

## Selected sources

- [source:operator-interview] Synthetic operator interview fixture — synthetic_transcript
